privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: SignatureOps stores organization admins, directory fields you enter or sync, templates, rules, campaigns, and brand assets. We do not route, relay, read, or store the bodies of email messages.
privacy.p2: Google signatures are written to Gmail sendAs settings when you deploy. Microsoft signatures are applied in the Outlook client at compose time via an add-in; they are not written through Microsoft Graph.
privacy.p3: Uploaded images are stored in object storage so they can be loaded by email clients. Admin sign-in uses Google OAuth. Invite links expire after seven days.
privacy.p4: Contact the organization that invited you for questions about their employee data.
